coreAbilities.name: DEADLY DEMISE
coreAbilities.summary: Explodes upon destruction, inflicting mortal wounds on nearby units.
coreAbilities.description: From detonating ammunition to the death throes of colossal beasts, some units violently erupt when destroyed. When a model with DEADLY DEMISE X is destroyed, roll one D6 before removing it from play. On a 6, each unit within 6" suffers X mortal wounds.

coreAbilities.name: DEEP STRIKE
coreAbilities.summary: Can start in Reserves and arrive anywhere on the battlefield >9" from enemies.
coreAbilities.description: During deployment, you can set up this unit in Reserves instead of setting it up on the battlefield. In the Reinforcements step of one of your Movement phases, you can set up this unit anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 9" horizontally away from all enemy models.

coreAbilities.name: FEEL NO PAIN
coreAbilities.summary: Post-damage roll to shrug off suffered wounds on X+.
coreAbilities.description: Each time a model with FEEL NO PAIN X+ suffers damage and would lose a wound, roll one D6. On an X+, that wound is not lost. Can be rolled against normal and mortal wounds.

coreAbilities.name: FIGHTS FIRST
coreAbilities.summary: Unit is eligible to fight in the Fights First step before standard combat.
coreAbilities.description: Units with FIGHTS FIRST are eligible to fight in the Fights First step of the Fight phase, before players alternate selecting eligible units to fight.

coreAbilities.name: FIRING DECK
coreAbilities.summary: Embarked passengers can fire up to X ranged weapons from the transport.
coreAbilities.description: Each time a TRANSPORT model with FIRING DECK X is selected to shoot, you can select up to X ranged weapons equipped by passengers embarked within it. This transport model is treated as being equipped with those weapons until that shooting is resolved.

coreAbilities.name: HOVER
coreAbilities.summary: Aircraft can opt to lose Aircraft rules and function as a standard Flyer.
coreAbilities.description: Before the battle, in the Declare Battle Formations step, you can select for this AIRCRAFT model to Hover. If it does, its Move characteristic becomes 20", it loses the AIRCRAFT keyword, and it no longer follows the Aircraft rules.

coreAbilities.name: INFILTRATORS
coreAbilities.summary: Can deploy anywhere outside the enemy deployment zone >9" from enemies.
coreAbilities.description: During deployment, a unit with INFILTRATORS can be set up anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 9" horizontally away from the enemy deployment zone and all enemy models.

coreAbilities.name: LEADER
coreAbilities.summary: Can attach to eligible Bodyguard units. Bodyguards can take 1 Leader and 1 Support.
coreAbilities.description: Before the battle in the Muster Armies step, a LEADER unit can attach to an eligible BODYGUARD unit to form an attached unit. In 11th edition, each bodyguard unit can have up to one LEADER and one SUPPORT unit attached.

coreAbilities.name: LONE OPERATIVE
coreAbilities.summary: Cannot be targeted by ranged attacks from more than 12" away (or X" if specified).
coreAbilities.description: Unless part of an attached unit, this unit can only be selected as the target of a ranged attack if the attacking model is within 12" (or the specified range X").

coreAbilities.name: SCOUTS
coreAbilities.summary: Pre-battle scout move of up to X" before the first turn begins.
coreAbilities.description: Units with SCOUTS X" can make a normal move of up to X" before the first battle round begins. If both players have Scout units, players alternate resolving Scout moves starting with the first turn player.

coreAbilities.name: STEALTH
coreAbilities.summary: Distorts targeting. -1 to Hit rolls made by enemy ranged attacks against this unit.
coreAbilities.description: Each time a ranged attack is made against a unit with STEALTH, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.

coreAbilities.name: SUPPORT
coreAbilities.summary: Specialist officer or support asset. Must attach to a bodyguard unit (1 Leader + 1 Support allowed).
coreAbilities.description: Before battle in the Muster Armies step, each SUPPORT unit in your army must be attached to an eligible BODYGUARD unit. In 11th edition, a bodyguard unit can have both a LEADER and a SUPPORT attached simultaneously.

coreAbilities.name: SUPER-HEAVY WALKER
coreAbilities.summary: Titanic walkers that can step over obstacles and non-Titanic models.
coreAbilities.description: Models in this unit can move through and over models (excluding TITANIC models) and can move horizontally over terrain features that are 4" or less in height as if they were not there.

coreAbilities.name: DAMAGED
coreAbilities.summary: Degrading performance characteristics when reduced to below half wounds.
coreAbilities.description: While this model has fewer than half its starting wounds remaining, its characteristics degrade (typically -1 to Hit rolls and/or reduced Objective Control).

weaponAbilities.name: [ANTI]
weaponAbilities.summary: Critical wound on unmodified wound roll of X+ against specified target keyword.
weaponAbilities.description: Weapons with [ANTI-KEYWORD X+] in their profile are designed to defeat specific opponents. Each time an attack is made with such a weapon against a target unit with the specified keyword, an unmodified wound roll of X+ scores a Critical Wound.

weaponAbilities.name: [ASSAULT]
weaponAbilities.summary: Allows shooting even if the bearer's unit Advanced this turn.
weaponAbilities.description: Weapons with [ASSAULT] can be fired on the move. A unit that contains one or more models equipped with an [ASSAULT] weapon is eligible to shoot in your Shooting phase even if that unit Advanced this turn, though only models equipped with [ASSAULT] weapons can make attacks.

weaponAbilities.name: [BLAST]
weaponAbilities.summary: Explosive ordnance. Adds attacks against large squads, cannot fire in Engagement Range.
weaponAbilities.description: Weapons with [BLAST] in their profile represent high-explosive payloads. Each time you determine how many attacks are made with a [BLAST] weapon, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic for every five models that were in the target unit in the Select Targets step (rounding down). Blast weapons cannot be used to make attacks against target units that are within Engagement Range of one or more friendly units.

weaponAbilities.name: [CLEAVE]
weaponAbilities.summary: Sweeping strikes. Adds attack dice for every 5 models in the target unit.
weaponAbilities.description: With sufficient might or skill, warriors may sweep blades or talons through their foes in long lethal arcs. This ability always takes the form [CLEAVE X]. Each time you gather attack dice for a [CLEAVE] weapon, if you only selected one target for all of that weapon’s attacks, add X additional attack dice for every five models that were in the target unit in the Select Targets step (rounding down).

weaponAbilities.name: [CLOSE-QUARTERS]
weaponAbilities.summary: Sidearm weapon that can be fired while locked in Engagement Range (identical to Pistol).
weaponAbilities.description: Weapons with [CLOSE-QUARTERS] can be fired at point-blank range while in Engagement Range of enemy units. A model equipped with a [CLOSE-QUARTERS] weapon can shoot with it even if its unit is within Engagement Range of enemy units. Identical in rules to [PISTOL].

weaponAbilities.name: [DEVASTATING WOUNDS]
weaponAbilities.summary: Critical wounds bypass armour and invulnerable saving throws.
weaponAbilities.description: Weapons with [DEVASTATING WOUNDS] can pierce almost any defense. A Critical Wound inflicted by an attack with this weapon cannot be saved against by armour or invulnerable saves — the target unit simply suffers the damage.

weaponAbilities.name: [EXTRA ATTACKS]
weaponAbilities.summary: Bearer attacks with this weapon in addition to other melee weapons.
weaponAbilities.description: A model equipped with an [EXTRA ATTACKS] weapon can attack with it in addition to any other melee weapons it selects to fight with. The Attacks characteristic of an [EXTRA ATTACKS] weapon cannot be modified.

weaponAbilities.name: [HAZARDOUS]
weaponAbilities.summary: Risk of weapon malfunction. Roll D6 per weapon used; roll of 1 destroys model or causes mortal wounds.
weaponAbilities.description: After resolving all attacks with [HAZARDOUS] weapons, roll one D6 for each [HAZARDOUS] weapon used. For each roll of 1, one model in the attacking unit equipped with that weapon suffers 3 mortal wounds (or is destroyed if it is a Character/Monster/Vehicle).

weaponAbilities.name: [HEAVY]
weaponAbilities.summary: +1 to Hit rolls if the firing unit Remained Stationary this turn.
weaponAbilities.description: Heavy weapons require bracing. Each time an attack is made with an [HEAVY] weapon, if the attacking model’s unit Remained Stationary this turn, add 1 to that attack’s Hit roll.

weaponAbilities.name: [IGNORES COVER]
weaponAbilities.summary: Target cannot gain the Benefit of Cover against these attacks.
weaponAbilities.description: Each time an attack is made with an [IGNORES COVER] weapon, the target cannot have the Benefit of Cover against that attack.

weaponAbilities.name: [INDIRECT FIRE]
weaponAbilities.summary: Can target non-visible enemy units (-1 to Hit, target gains Benefit of Cover).
weaponAbilities.description: Weapons with [INDIRECT FIRE] can make attacks against targets that are not visible to the attacking model. If an attack is made against a target that is not visible, subtract 1 from the Hit roll and the target has the Benefit of Cover against that attack.

weaponAbilities.name: [LANCE]
weaponAbilities.summary: +1 to Wound rolls if the bearer charged this turn.
weaponAbilities.description: Each time an attack is made with a [LANCE] weapon, if the bearer made a charge move this turn, add 1 to that attack’s Wound roll.

weaponAbilities.name: [LETHAL HITS]
weaponAbilities.summary: Critical hits automatically wound the target.
weaponAbilities.description: Each time an attack is made with a [LETHAL HITS] weapon, a Critical Hit automatically wounds the target without needing a wound roll.

weaponAbilities.name: [MELTA]
weaponAbilities.summary: Thermal armor-melting blast. Adds +X Damage at half range.
weaponAbilities.description: Weapons with [MELTA X] unleash blinding heat. Each time an attack made with a [MELTA X] weapon targets a unit within half that weapon’s Range, that attack’s Damage characteristic is increased by X.

weaponAbilities.name: [ONE SHOT]
weaponAbilities.summary: Single-use weapon that can only be fired once per battle.
weaponAbilities.description: The bearer can only shoot with this weapon once per battle.

weaponAbilities.name: [PISTOL]
weaponAbilities.summary: Can shoot in Engagement Range. Functionally identical to [CLOSE-QUARTERS].
weaponAbilities.description: Weapons with [PISTOL] can shoot while their unit is in Engagement Range of enemy units, targeting those enemy units. Functionally identical to [CLOSE-QUARTERS].

weaponAbilities.name: [PRECISION]
weaponAbilities.summary: Attacking player can allocate successful attacks directly to a visible Character in an Attached unit.
weaponAbilities.description: When an attack made with a [PRECISION] weapon successfully wounds an attached unit, if a CHARACTER model in that unit is visible to the attacking model, the attacking player can allocate that attack directly to that CHARACTER model instead of the bodyguard unit.

weaponAbilities.name: [PSYCHIC]
weaponAbilities.summary: Psychic manifestation weapon or attack, interacts with [ANTI-PSYKER].
weaponAbilities.description: Weapons and abilities with the [PSYCHIC] tag represent manifestations of warp powers. Interacts directly with abilities that confer defense or bonuses against psychic attacks (such as [ANTI-PSYKER] or psychic protection).

weaponAbilities.name: [RAPID FIRE]
weaponAbilities.summary: Adds +X Attacks when firing at targets within half range.
weaponAbilities.description: Weapons with [RAPID FIRE X] deliver high rates of fire at close range. Each time an attack made with such a weapon targets a unit within half range, increase the Attacks characteristic by X.

weaponAbilities.name: [SUSTAINED HITS]
weaponAbilities.summary: Critical hits generate X additional hits on the target.
weaponAbilities.description: Each time an attack is made with a [SUSTAINED HITS X] weapon, a Critical Hit scores X additional hits on the target unit in addition to the normal hit.

weaponAbilities.name: [TORRENT]
weaponAbilities.summary: Cones of fire/acid/flame. Attacks automatically hit the target without rolling.
weaponAbilities.description: Weapons with [TORRENT] project continuous streams of fire, acid, or gas. Attacks made with a [TORRENT] weapon automatically hit the target without making a Hit roll. Cannot have [INDIRECT FIRE] or [PRECISION].

weaponAbilities.name: [TWIN-LINKED]
weaponAbilities.summary: Paired weapon synchronization. You can re-roll all Wound rolls made with this weapon.
weaponAbilities.description: Weapons with [TWIN-LINKED] feature synchronized barrels or power conduits. Each time an attack is made with a [TWIN-LINKED] weapon, you can re-roll the Wound roll.

allKeywordsList.name: [ANTI]
allKeywordsList.summary: Critical wound on unmodified wound roll of X+ against specified target keyword.
allKeywordsList.description: Weapons with [ANTI-KEYWORD X+] in their profile are designed to defeat specific opponents. Each time an attack is made with such a weapon against a target unit with the specified keyword, an unmodified wound roll of X+ scores a Critical Wound.

allKeywordsList.name: [ASSAULT]
allKeywordsList.summary: Allows shooting even if the bearer's unit Advanced this turn.
allKeywordsList.description: Weapons with [ASSAULT] can be fired on the move. A unit that contains one or more models equipped with an [ASSAULT] weapon is eligible to shoot in your Shooting phase even if that unit Advanced this turn, though only models equipped with [ASSAULT] weapons can make attacks.

allKeywordsList.name: [BLAST]
allKeywordsList.summary: Explosive ordnance. Adds attacks against large squads, cannot fire in Engagement Range.
allKeywordsList.description: Weapons with [BLAST] in their profile represent high-explosive payloads. Each time you determine how many attacks are made with a [BLAST] weapon, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic for every five models that were in the target unit in the Select Targets step (rounding down). Blast weapons cannot be used to make attacks against target units that are within Engagement Range of one or more friendly units.

allKeywordsList.name: [CLEAVE]
allKeywordsList.summary: Sweeping strikes. Adds attack dice for every 5 models in the target unit.
allKeywordsList.description: With sufficient might or skill, warriors may sweep blades or talons through their foes in long lethal arcs. This ability always takes the form [CLEAVE X]. Each time you gather attack dice for a [CLEAVE] weapon, if you only selected one target for all of that weapon’s attacks, add X additional attack dice for every five models that were in the target unit in the Select Targets step (rounding down).

allKeywordsList.name: [CLOSE-QUARTERS]
allKeywordsList.summary: Sidearm weapon that can be fired while locked in Engagement Range (identical to Pistol).
allKeywordsList.description: Weapons with [CLOSE-QUARTERS] can be fired at point-blank range while in Engagement Range of enemy units. A model equipped with a [CLOSE-QUARTERS] weapon can shoot with it even if its unit is within Engagement Range of enemy units. Identical in rules to [PISTOL].

allKeywordsList.name: DEADLY DEMISE
allKeywordsList.summary: Explodes upon destruction, inflicting mortal wounds on nearby units.
allKeywordsList.description: From detonating ammunition to the death throes of colossal beasts, some units violently erupt when destroyed. When a model with DEADLY DEMISE X is destroyed, roll one D6 before removing it from play. On a 6, each unit within 6" suffers X mortal wounds.

allKeywordsList.name: DEEP STRIKE
allKeywordsList.summary: Can start in Reserves and arrive anywhere on the battlefield >9" from enemies.
allKeywordsList.description: During deployment, you can set up this unit in Reserves instead of setting it up on the battlefield. In the Reinforcements step of one of your Movement phases, you can set up this unit anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 9" horizontally away from all enemy models.

allKeywordsList.name: [DEVASTATING WOUNDS]
allKeywordsList.summary: Critical wounds bypass armour and invulnerable saving throws.
allKeywordsList.description: Weapons with [DEVASTATING WOUNDS] can pierce almost any defense. A Critical Wound inflicted by an attack with this weapon cannot be saved against by armour or invulnerable saves — the target unit simply suffers the damage.

allKeywordsList.name: [EXTRA ATTACKS]
allKeywordsList.summary: Bearer attacks with this weapon in addition to other melee weapons.
allKeywordsList.description: A model equipped with an [EXTRA ATTACKS] weapon can attack with it in addition to any other melee weapons it selects to fight with. The Attacks characteristic of an [EXTRA ATTACKS] weapon cannot be modified.

allKeywordsList.name: FEEL NO PAIN
allKeywordsList.summary: Post-damage roll to shrug off suffered wounds on X+.
allKeywordsList.description: Each time a model with FEEL NO PAIN X+ suffers damage and would lose a wound, roll one D6. On an X+, that wound is not lost. Can be rolled against normal and mortal wounds.

allKeywordsList.name: FIGHTS FIRST
allKeywordsList.summary: Unit is eligible to fight in the Fights First step before standard combat.
allKeywordsList.description: Units with FIGHTS FIRST are eligible to fight in the Fights First step of the Fight phase, before players alternate selecting eligible units to fight.

allKeywordsList.name: FIRING DECK
allKeywordsList.summary: Embarked passengers can fire up to X ranged weapons from the transport.
allKeywordsList.description: Each time a TRANSPORT model with FIRING DECK X is selected to shoot, you can select up to X ranged weapons equipped by passengers embarked within it. This transport model is treated as being equipped with those weapons until that shooting is resolved.

allKeywordsList.name: [HAZARDOUS]
allKeywordsList.summary: Risk of weapon malfunction. Roll D6 per weapon used; roll of 1 destroys model or causes mortal wounds.
allKeywordsList.description: After resolving all attacks with [HAZARDOUS] weapons, roll one D6 for each [HAZARDOUS] weapon used. For each roll of 1, one model in the attacking unit equipped with that weapon suffers 3 mortal wounds (or is destroyed if it is a Character/Monster/Vehicle).

allKeywordsList.name: [HEAVY]
allKeywordsList.summary: +1 to Hit rolls if the firing unit Remained Stationary this turn.
allKeywordsList.description: Heavy weapons require bracing. Each time an attack is made with an [HEAVY] weapon, if the attacking model’s unit Remained Stationary this turn, add 1 to that attack’s Hit roll.

allKeywordsList.name: HOVER
allKeywordsList.summary: Aircraft can opt to lose Aircraft rules and function as a standard Flyer.
allKeywordsList.description: Before the battle, in the Declare Battle Formations step, you can select for this AIRCRAFT model to Hover. If it does, its Move characteristic becomes 20", it loses the AIRCRAFT keyword, and it no longer follows the Aircraft rules.

allKeywordsList.name: [IGNORES COVER]
allKeywordsList.summary: Target cannot gain the Benefit of Cover against these attacks.
allKeywordsList.description: Each time an attack is made with an [IGNORES COVER] weapon, the target cannot have the Benefit of Cover against that attack.

allKeywordsList.name: [INDIRECT FIRE]
allKeywordsList.summary: Can target non-visible enemy units (-1 to Hit, target gains Benefit of Cover).
allKeywordsList.description: Weapons with [INDIRECT FIRE] can make attacks against targets that are not visible to the attacking model. If an attack is made against a target that is not visible, subtract 1 from the Hit roll and the target has the Benefit of Cover against that attack.

allKeywordsList.name: INFILTRATORS
allKeywordsList.summary: Can deploy anywhere outside the enemy deployment zone >9" from enemies.
allKeywordsList.description: During deployment, a unit with INFILTRATORS can be set up anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 9" horizontally away from the enemy deployment zone and all enemy models.

allKeywordsList.name: [LANCE]
allKeywordsList.summary: +1 to Wound rolls if the bearer charged this turn.
allKeywordsList.description: Each time an attack is made with a [LANCE] weapon, if the bearer made a charge move this turn, add 1 to that attack’s Wound roll.

allKeywordsList.name: LEADER
allKeywordsList.summary: Can attach to eligible Bodyguard units. Bodyguards can take 1 Leader and 1 Support.
allKeywordsList.description: Before the battle in the Muster Armies step, a LEADER unit can attach to an eligible BODYGUARD unit to form an attached unit. In 11th edition, each bodyguard unit can have up to one LEADER and one SUPPORT unit attached.

allKeywordsList.name: [LETHAL HITS]
allKeywordsList.summary: Critical hits automatically wound the target.
allKeywordsList.description: Each time an attack is made with a [LETHAL HITS] weapon, a Critical Hit automatically wounds the target without needing a wound roll.

allKeywordsList.name: LONE OPERATIVE
allKeywordsList.summary: Cannot be targeted by ranged attacks from more than 12" away (or X" if specified).
allKeywordsList.description: Unless part of an attached unit, this unit can only be selected as the target of a ranged attack if the attacking model is within 12" (or the specified range X").

allKeywordsList.name: [MELTA]
allKeywordsList.summary: Thermal armor-melting blast. Adds +X Damage at half range.
allKeywordsList.description: Weapons with [MELTA X] unleash blinding heat. Each time an attack made with a [MELTA X] weapon targets a unit within half that weapon’s Range, that attack’s Damage characteristic is increased by X.

allKeywordsList.name: [ONE SHOT]
allKeywordsList.summary: Single-use weapon that can only be fired once per battle.
allKeywordsList.description: The bearer can only shoot with this weapon once per battle.

allKeywordsList.name: [PISTOL]
allKeywordsList.summary: Can shoot in Engagement Range. Functionally identical to [CLOSE-QUARTERS].
allKeywordsList.description: Weapons with [PISTOL] can shoot while their unit is in Engagement Range of enemy units, targeting those enemy units. Functionally identical to [CLOSE-QUARTERS].

allKeywordsList.name: [PRECISION]
allKeywordsList.summary: Attacking player can allocate successful attacks directly to a visible Character in an Attached unit.
allKeywordsList.description: When an attack made with a [PRECISION] weapon successfully wounds an attached unit, if a CHARACTER model in that unit is visible to the attacking model, the attacking player can allocate that attack directly to that CHARACTER model instead of the bodyguard unit.

allKeywordsList.name: [PSYCHIC]
allKeywordsList.summary: Psychic manifestation weapon or attack, interacts with [ANTI-PSYKER].
allKeywordsList.description: Weapons and abilities with the [PSYCHIC] tag represent manifestations of warp powers. Interacts directly with abilities that confer defense or bonuses against psychic attacks (such as [ANTI-PSYKER] or psychic protection).

allKeywordsList.name: [RAPID FIRE]
allKeywordsList.summary: Adds +X Attacks when firing at targets within half range.
allKeywordsList.description: Weapons with [RAPID FIRE X] deliver high rates of fire at close range. Each time an attack made with such a weapon targets a unit within half range, increase the Attacks characteristic by X.

allKeywordsList.name: SCOUTS
allKeywordsList.summary: Pre-battle scout move of up to X" before the first turn begins.
allKeywordsList.description: Units with SCOUTS X" can make a normal move of up to X" before the first battle round begins. If both players have Scout units, players alternate resolving Scout moves starting with the first turn player.

allKeywordsList.name: STEALTH
allKeywordsList.summary: Distorts targeting. -1 to Hit rolls made by enemy ranged attacks against this unit.
allKeywordsList.description: Each time a ranged attack is made against a unit with STEALTH, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.

allKeywordsList.name: SUPPORT
allKeywordsList.summary: Specialist officer or support asset. Must attach to a bodyguard unit (1 Leader + 1 Support allowed).
allKeywordsList.description: Before battle in the Muster Armies step, each SUPPORT unit in your army must be attached to an eligible BODYGUARD unit. In 11th edition, a bodyguard unit can have both a LEADER and a SUPPORT attached simultaneously.

allKeywordsList.name: SUPER-HEAVY WALKER
allKeywordsList.summary: Titanic walkers that can step over obstacles and non-Titanic models.
allKeywordsList.description: Models in this unit can move through and over models (excluding TITANIC models) and can move horizontally over terrain features that are 4" or less in height as if they were not there.

allKeywordsList.name: [SUSTAINED HITS]
allKeywordsList.summary: Critical hits generate X additional hits on the target.
allKeywordsList.description: Each time an attack is made with a [SUSTAINED HITS X] weapon, a Critical Hit scores X additional hits on the target unit in addition to the normal hit.

allKeywordsList.name: [TORRENT]
allKeywordsList.summary: Cones of fire/acid/flame. Attacks automatically hit the target without rolling.
allKeywordsList.description: Weapons with [TORRENT] project continuous streams of fire, acid, or gas. Attacks made with a [TORRENT] weapon automatically hit the target without making a Hit roll. Cannot have [INDIRECT FIRE] or [PRECISION].

allKeywordsList.name: [TWIN-LINKED]
allKeywordsList.summary: Paired weapon synchronization. You can re-roll all Wound rolls made with this weapon.
allKeywordsList.description: Weapons with [TWIN-LINKED] feature synchronized barrels or power conduits. Each time an attack is made with a [TWIN-LINKED] weapon, you can re-roll the Wound roll.

allKeywordsList.name: DAMAGED
allKeywordsList.summary: Degrading performance characteristics when reduced to below half wounds.
allKeywordsList.description: While this model has fewer than half its starting wounds remaining, its characteristics degrade (typically -1 to Hit rolls and/or reduced Objective Control).

allKeywordsList.name: BENEFIT OF COVER
allKeywordsList.summary: Adds +1 to armor saving throws against ranged attacks (does not improve 3+ saves against AP 0).
allKeywordsList.description: Each time a ranged attack is allocated to a model that has the Benefit of Cover, add 1 to the saving throw made for that attack (excluding invulnerable saving throws). Models with a Save characteristic of 3+ or better cannot have the Benefit of Cover against attacks with an Armour Penetration characteristic of 0.

allKeywordsList.name: MORTAL WOUNDS
allKeywordsList.summary: Unstoppable damage that bypasses normal Armor and Invulnerable saves and spills over between models.
allKeywordsList.description: Each mortal wound inflicted on a unit causes one model in that unit to lose one wound. No saving throws of any kind can be made against mortal wounds (though Feel No Pain rules can be used). Unlike normal attacks, excess mortal wounds are not lost when a model is destroyed and continue to be allocated to other models in the target unit.

allKeywordsList.name: BATTLE-SHOCK
allKeywordsList.summary: Battle-shocked units have OC 0, cannot be targeted by friendly Stratagems, and must take Desperate Escape tests if Falling Back.
allKeywordsList.description: While a unit is Battle-shocked: the Objective Control characteristic of all its models is 0; if it is selected to Fall Back, you must take a Desperate Escape test for every model in that unit; and its controlling player cannot use Stratagems to affect that unit.
